findingDetails.title: The record-detail panel closes on window resize instead of satisfying the sheet's resize-preservation contract
findingDetails.evidence: onResize calls close whenever the body is not editing, while AC-003 requires an open sheet to survive resize.
findingDetails.recommendation: Preserve and reposition a sheet on resize; keep close behavior only for presentation states that require it.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Record-detail source and phase 003 acceptance criteria are in target scope.

findingDetails.title: Sheet placement can compute bounds from the global active document even when the panel belongs to another document
findingDetails.evidence: placeSheet's default bounds call reaches getVisiblePopoverBounds(null), which selects window.activeDocument.
findingDetails.recommendation: Resolve bounds from panel.ownerDocument/defaultView or pass owner-scoped bounds at every sheet call.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Popover positioning is in the configured source scope.

findingDetails.title: Anchor lease fallback timeout has no evidence-backed budget for asynchronous rebuilds
findingDetails.evidence: Default pending timeout is 250ms, but no inspected phase evidence establishes the slowest replacement-anchor latency.
findingDetails.recommendation: Measure the rebuild latency or make the timeout a documented host contract with a transition test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Anchor lease is explicitly named by phase 003 and in source scope.
